Telugu phrase 'Idupu Kayitham' sparks social media debate in Andhra-Telangana

The Telugu phrase 'Idupu Kayitham', which translates to 'waist paper' or 'hip paper', has become a subject of social media discussion and controversy across Andhra Pradesh and Telangana. The phrase has reportedly been used in a context that has led to mockery and debate about dignity. The nature of the usage and the specific context causing the controversy remain unclear from the provided information.
